text: The radar locked card has flex-direction: row at radar.css:133. Set it to column, then check ops.css for other row layouts.
command: cd /work/apps/canvas/src/ops && sed -i '133s/flex-direction: row;/flex-direction: column;/' radar.css && nl -ba radar.css | sed -n '133p' && grep -n 'flex-direction' ops.css | head -30
